verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the Privacy & Cybersecurity practice page. It describes compliance, assessment and implementation-focused boutique services. It never mentions security-incident or breach response, or regulator-facing work such as notifications or investigations. That makes it an adjacent practice description rather than documented breach-response capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Fenwick has built an integrated team of lawyers and former industry privacy and cybersecurity officers who provide comprehensive compliance, assessment and legal 'boutique' services focused on implementation.
